- memory_id "1000378": The Cinder team reported on 2025-04-24 that feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)

- memory_id "1000281" [decision]: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000263" [decision]: The Ember team owns the billing API as of 2025-03-07, when ownership passed from the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000250": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team, which took over ownership from the Boreal team on 2025-03-03.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000246": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)

- memory_id "1000232": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, cache change)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier depends on the bus for delivery events, so it is down whenever the bus is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000183" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000180" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000171": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14, partitioning work)
- memory_id "1000136": The Ember team owns the job scheduler.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000105": Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000043": The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
